CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers? (1 mark)
   A. Use Healing the 10 Lepers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers.
   C. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Healing the 10 Lepers has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Judge Deborah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Judge Deborah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Judge Deborah.

   D. Apply the teaching of Judge Deborah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif? (1 mark)

   C. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)

   C. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
